news.title: Gianni Infantino to run for re-election despite failed World Cup sell-off plan
news.lede: FIFA President Gianni Infantino will stand for re-election despite growing calls for him to step down as head of world football’s governing body. Infantino has faced increasing pressure after his controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup was met with a furious backlash. But FIFA said on Sunday (September 6, 2026) that he plans to stand again in next year's elections for a final term in office through 2031. "The FIFA President announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027.

news.title: Allys Clipsham to help officiate FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup match
news.lede: New Zealand referee Allys Clipsham will make her first appearance at the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup when she helps officiate the Group E match between Costa Rica and Colombia. Dunedin-based Clipsham will be the assistant referee for the match at the Stadion Miejski ŁKS Łódz, in Poland at 4am (NZT) on Tuesday. Her appointment follows her debut on the FIFA international panel in 2025, and follows her work at last year’s FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. Clipsham, who is the referee development manager for Football South, began her refereeing career in 2010 and was named New Zealand Football’s Assistant Referee of the Year in 2021.

news.title: Italy gives US a scare and China edges Czech Republic in women’s FIBA World Cup
news.lede: BERLIN: Italy gave the United States a huge scare in the women’s FIBA World Cup on Sunday, while China needed overtime to edge the Czech Republic 74-70 in another thriller. The US survived its toughest test at the tournament in two decades with a 55-52 win over Italy, with Jackie Young scoring 10 points. It stretched the Americans’ winning run at the World Cup to 32 games, but none of them have been closer. Italy trailed by 15 points early in the second quarter, but fought back through Olbis Andre and Cecilia Zandalasini as they cut the gap to six points before the break.

news.title: ‘Embarrassment’: Young Socceroos hit 20-year low as rising star leaves Man Utd for A-League
news.lede: After winning the continental title in China last year, the Young Socceroos have failed to qualify for next year’s Under 20 Asian Cup in a bitter blow to Australian football. A 2-0 loss to Indonesia at New Laos National Stadium in Vientiane, Laos condemned the Young Socceroos to a third-place finish in their qualifying group with only the top two advancing to next year’s tournament in China. news.title: Egypt file complaint against referee after World Cup exit
